title: Topic 16 | Projectile motion at an angle to the horizontal

questions.text: What is the trajectory of a body thrown at an angle to the horizontal? Neglect air resistance.
answers: a straight line inclined to the horizontal

questions.text: The figure shows the trajectory of a body thrown at an angle α to the horizontal with speed v. Which of the vectors shown in the figure indicates the direction of the body's acceleration at point A?
What is the acceleration of a body thrown at an angle to the horizontal?
answers: g, directed along the velocity vector
